Preserve the exact product identity from the reference image: shape, silhouette, proportions, color, material, surface finish, label/logo placement, and visible construction details. Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. Keep the label text exactly legible and unchanged; do not redraw or restyle any logo. Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium Nordic-simple home furnishing visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte off-white wall #F2EFEA, warm grey-brown cabinet carcass #5A544E, light oak plank floor #C8A87C, and one warm brass accent #C9A15E; neutral temperature; modern geometric sans-serif with Chinese in-image copy wrapped in corner brackets; real nordic apartment interior backgrounds, never a studio cyclorama; soft 5500K daylight key from the left plus raking side light on glass, mirror and metal surfaces, warm accent light inside the glazed upper compartment; single-weight thin line icons in #2D2D2D; stable product scale with a real furniture or tableware anchor, corrected verticals, soft believable contact shadows; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented certifications or spec numbers. {product} shown whole with the counter deployed, photographed from a low 15-degree angle at floor level looking up along the base rail and legs, unit kept upright with corrected verticals. Bright even high-key 5500K daylight from camera left with a warm brass glow from inside the glazed compartment, raking side light along the base and the metal leg feet, soft contact shadow under the feet and the counter edge. Matte off-white wall #F2EFEA with warm oak plank floor #C8A87C, generous clear wall above the unit, one framed print at the far right only, no clutter. Product occupies 50-60% of frame. Generous lower band carrying one row of four single-weight thin-line icons in #2D2D2D with four short Chinese labels wrapped in 「」 at 12pt, describing only verifiable structure, material and build. Landscape 4:3 crop, 2K. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, lab reports, ratings, sales figures or test data; no fake seals, no fake logo, no brand name, no watermark, no QR code, no dense body text, no hands, no floating product, no mixed icon weights.

provenance.notes: 由 1 张详情页长图的 9 个切片提炼。源文件夹名'家装家具家用品-酒柜'中的品类落在 L1'家具家纺'（源夹命名更宽泛，主体为独立式木质吧台酒柜，非灯具或建材，故不归'家装灯具'），L2 依待客储酒功能取'餐厅家具'。已剥离：品牌与店铺名、会员入口与二维码、鹿头与成组装饰画等源图专属陈设、全部原文案（改为 {selling_point_1} 与 {callout_1}..{callout_16} 占位符）、进口木材产地与材质等级表述、瓶数与尺寸数值。未生成任何认证、检测、评分或销量事实。
